body: The text is not contrast enough in expandable panels: Were is buggy whitespace arrangement for radio buttons, we need to find a way to make everything look nice, aligned, and compact with not too much whitespace: We need to have some way of providing details on what exactly is different about each interpretation (like using parentheses with entity full name, or name + meaning, or meaning only) or just replacing the original word with entity name. I think we should make all ways of showing alternative versions be switchable, so id only is also one of the options. Also alternative interpretations should be switchable, meaning if I click one of them - result changes (replaced with alternative variant. And also the shown result should be in this top 10 most probable variants. That should be more userfriendly, and we need to make sure our UI support language switching and detection, theme switching and detection, and also mobile first friendly. But also space on desktops should be used wisely. We need to collect data related about the issue to this repository, make sure we compile that data to `./docs/case-studies/issue-{id}` folder, and use it to do deep case study analysis (also make sure to search online for additional facts and data), list of each and all requirements from the issue, and propose possible solutions and solution plans for each requirement (we should also check known existing components/libraries, that solve similar problem or can help in solutions). Please plan and execute everything in a single pull request, you have unlimited time and context, as context auto-compacts and you can continue indefinitely, until it is each and every requirement fully addressed, and everything is totally done.
title: UI/UX improvements
